title: Antony and Cleopatra

vibeProfile.oneLine: A Roman general throws away an empire for the queen of Egypt.

summary: Torn between his duty to Rome and his consuming passion for the Egyptian queen Cleopatra, the great general Mark Antony sacrifices an empire for love, in a sweeping tragedy that moves between two worlds. Shakespeare's grandest late tragedy gives Cleopatra one of the richest roles ever written for a woman, and its poetry soars as the lovers ruin themselves magnificently. Expansive, sensuous and deeply moving, it is a mature masterpiece about love, power and the theatre of a life lived large.
whyReadIt: Shakespeare's grandest late tragedy, and Cleopatra is one of the greatest roles ever written. Sweeping and sensuous.

funFacts.text: Cleopatra has more lines than almost any other female character in Shakespeare.
